spans.s: भष् भषति भष˚ते bark.

1 भस् ब॑भस्ति ब॑प्सति pp. भसित (q.v.) chew,
devour, consume.
2 भस् (only loc. भसि) ashes.
1 भा॑स् n. (older than) f. light, brightness.

2 भास् भा॑सति भा॑स˚ते pp. भासित॑ (q.v.) shine,
be bright, appear as or like (nom. or instr.), become clear or obvious,
be imagined or conceived. C. भासयति, ˚ते make shine, illuminate,
cause to appear as (instr.), show, manifest. — अव M. shine, light,
become manifest, appear as (instr. or adv. in वत्). C. shine upon,
illumine. आ M. appear as (इव). उद् shine forth, make a show, catch
the eye. C. illumine (M.), illustrate, embellish. समुद् shine with
(instr.). निस् C. illumine. परि M. appear, look like (इव). C.
beautify, adorn. प्र shine, be bright, appear like (इव). C.
illumine, illustrate. प्रति M. shine forth, become manifest, appear
like (nom.) or as (instr. of an abstr.), be brilliant, make a show. C.
show, manifest. वि shine, be bright.
भष॑ a. barking.
भषक m. barker, dog.
भाषक a. speaking, talking about (—˚).
भस॑द् f. the hinder parts, pudendum muliebre.
भसद्य॑ a. being on the hinder parts (v. prec.).
भसित a. consumed to ashes.
भासित॑ a. shining, brilliant.
भ॑स्त्रा f. bag, sack, bellows.
भस्त्रिका f. little bag, pouch, purse.
भस्मकृत a. made into ashes.
भस्मता f. abstr. to seq. n.

भ॑स्मन् a. chewing, devouring. n. (also pl.) ashes, abl.
भस्मतस्.
भस्मभूत a. reduced to ashes.
भस्म॑राशी@कृ change into a heap of ashes.
भस्मरेणु m. dust of ashes.
भस्मशायिन् a. lying on ashes.
1 भस्मान्त n. neighbourhood of (loc. near) ashes.
2 भ॑स्मान्त a. ending in ashes, being finally burnt.
भस्मान्ति adv. = prec. 1 loc.
भस्माप् f. pl. water with ashes.

भस्मावशेष a. reduced to ashes (lit. of what only
ashes remain).
भस्मित a. made into ashes, consumed, destroyed.
भस्मी@कृ & भू = भस्मसात् w. the same.
भस्मीकरण n. burning to ashes.
भस्मीभाव m. being or becoming ashes.
भस्मीभूत a. reduced to or being mere ashes.
भाषण n. speaking, talking.
भाषाज्ञ a. knowing languages.

भाषिक a. dialectical;
 f. आ language.
भाषितव्य a. to be spoken to.
भा॑षितृ a. speaking (acc. or —˚).

भाषिन् a. speaking, talking (mostly —˚);
 loquacious.
भासिन् (—˚) & भासुर a. = prec.

भास्य a. to be (being) brought to light or made visible;
abstr. ˚त्व n.

भाष्यकार m. the writer of a commentary, E. of
PataJjali.

भाष्य˚कृत् m. the writer of a commentary, E. of
PataJjali.
भासता f. the state of the bird Bhāsa.
भा॑सद m. buttock.
भासन n. shining, glittering, excelling.
1 भा॑सस् n. light, lustre.
2 भा॑सस् n. food.
भासुरदेह a. of radiant aspect (body).
भास्करनन्दिन् m. son of the god of the sun.
भास्मन a. ashy.

भा॑स्वन्त् a. shining, brilliant;
 m. the sun.
भास्वर॑ a. = prec. a.
